title: Operator profile
description: operator.yaml in an operator's private repository: the business choices one operator (the entity that holds products, banks for them, keeps their books and chooses their vendors) makes once for every product it holds, as data a product reads at spawn and stamps into its own docs/holdco.md, config and launch checklist. Choices only: no secrets, tax ids, account or card numbers, or anyone's home address (operator-holds-no-secrets), and no skills, agent definitions or jobs. Patterns carry placeholders the product fills: {product} (its slug), {Product} (its display name), {product_domain}, {product_legal_name}, and per-pattern ones such as {Vendor}, {Platform} and {purpose}. A value that names another field of this profile (public_address, legal_entity_pattern) means that field's value. Nothing public depends on the file; a product points up to it by a breadcrumb (SUITE.md, The operator).

schema.description: The format and its major version; a reader refuses a major it does not know.

as_of.description: The day the choices were last checked against the operator's decision log.

naming.description: How each product's accounts, projects and channels are named, one pattern per account kind (repo, bank account, payment account, cloud project, analytics project, chat channels).

vendors.description: Need → vendor, the operator's default for every product it holds. A product's own vendors beyond these are its own decision.

money.description: Where money lives: the bank, the accounts each product gets and the company's own, the cards, where payouts land. Account names are patterns; account numbers never appear.

payouts_to.description: The account a product's payment processor pays out to.

tax.description: Tax settings a product inherits: the accounting method, what counts as revenue, sales tax, where it may sell, and information returns. Free text where the law decides; the operator's accountant confirms each.

revenue.description: gross: the full charge is revenue and payouts to others are costs; net: only the operator's share is revenue.

selling_regions.description: Region lists by kind of sale (physical_goods, blocked_until_vat): ISO 3166 codes, or EU and UK.

legal.description: What a product's legal pages and designations name: the name in its terms, the address in its privacy footer, its copyright agent.

gates.description: Conditions a human ticks before a kind of money is switched on in a product's production, one before_<kind> list per kind: before_payments (required: money is never taken before the entity and its bank exist), before_physical_sales, or another the operator names. Each product copies the rows into docs/holdco.md as a checklist, and its deploy check fails production with a held ENABLE_* toggle on while a row is unticked.

spawn.description: The company-side steps for a new product, in order: filings, accounts, vendor projects. A product's spawn prints them as a human checklist; a human approves money movement, filings and anything signed.

choice.description: A choice in words: a sentence or pattern, a list of them, or a map of named choices.

entity.description: The legal entity that holds every product.

jurisdiction.description: Where it is formed: ISO 3166-1 or 3166-2 (US-DE, GB).

brand_rule.description: How a product trades under the entity (a DBA per product, filed after clearance).

legal_entity_pattern.description: The entity line every product's terms, privacy page and receipts print, with placeholders: Acme Holdings LLC (dba {product_legal_name}). Absent, the legal_name.

public_address.description: The one address a product may print. TBD until it exists; a product keeps money off until its legal pages name it.

provider.description: Who provides it (a registered agent, a virtual office).

never.description: Addresses that must not be used in its place.

contacts.description: Contact role → address or description: ops (billing and notices, never a login), legal, login, support (a pattern such as support@{product_domain}), phone.

need.description: What a product needs (payments, email, servers). Quote it in a YAML flow mapping when it holds commas.

toggle.description: The product's switch for this vendor's real-money or outbound effect: an ENABLE_* key in its config, false outside production.

when.description: The kind of product that uses it (marketplace, physical goods); absent, every product.

spendCap.description: Monthly ceilings, each key ending in its ISO 4217 currency code: app_monthly_usd (the product stops calling at it), provider_cap_usd (the vendor's own hard cap), alert_usd (the billing alert).

gateRows.description: Conditions, each one a human can tick (the entity is approved, the bank account exists).
